description.value: A private forested campground beside a small creek on mid-Vancouver Island, with serviced tent sites, hot showers, Wi-Fi, and natural spring water; handy to Nanaimo and BC Ferries but primarily an RV park that also takes tents.

address.value: 2212 Island Hwy E, Nanoose Bay, BC V9P 9A8, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground with both RV and tent sites, Wi-Fi, free hot showers, natural spring water, and year-round campfires.
